about: The shared pool: the roots every pane may name by use -- the fonts, the text sizes from tiny to huge and the colours -- and the styles made of them. A font names the face it sets text in; a size, the points it stands at, which a terminal sets in its one cell; a style, a font, a size and a colour, each a root's name, and a weight. A colour has the colour it paints where a theme sets none; what a terminal shows for it is the terminal's own look, graphics/terminal.json. These defaults are the window's own palette, night's.

fonts.name: text
fonts.about: the face every text is set in: monospaced, embedded in the window, regular and bold

sizes.name: tiny
sizes.about: the smallest words: a mark's label

sizes.name: huge
sizes.about: the largest words: a title over a whole surface

styles.name: caption

styles.name: body
styles.about: ordinary text: what a text naming no style is set in

styles.name: heading
styles.about: a heading over a part of a pane

styles.name: title
styles.about: a title over a whole surface

colors.name: ground
colors.about: the medium's own ground: what shows where nothing is drawn

colors.name: background
colors.about: opaque, empty material beneath content

colors.name: text
colors.about: ordinary authored material

colors.name: quiet

colors.name: accent

colors.name: alert

colors.name: guide

colors.name: surface

colors.name: chosen

colors.name: veil

colors.name: soft

colors.name: frame_transient

colors.name: secondary

colors.name: background_alt
